comment: 55yo healthy adult (male) — no personal cancer diagnosis, no first-degree-relative cancer history, no documented age-appropriate cancer screening completed within the past 5+ years. Never-smoker (no LDCT applicability), no documented CRC modality on file (no colonoscopy / FIT / CTC / FIT-DNA), no documented PSA discussion or testing in last decade. Universal demographic screening-gap RF cohort: pre-clinical malignancy detection below USPSTF / NCCN / NCI population-screening cadence. Sister to existing patient_age_55_screening_gap.json (55yo female; this case is 55yo male — different sex-specific screening profile). Engine fires RF-UNIVERSAL-AGE-50PLUS-SCREENING-GAP (composite trigger: age>=50 AND age_50plus_screening_gap_documented:true; relevant_diseases:['*'] — sidecar documentation per plan.py exclusion) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = comprehensive USPSTF catch-up — CRC modality choice per USPSTF 2021 (colonoscopy q10y / FIT q1y / CTC q5y / FIT-DNA q3y for 45-75 with extension to 76-85 individualized) + shared-decision PSA discussion per USPSTF 2018 (50-69 individualized) + skin-cancer awareness given age; alternative = highest-yield-only modality (FIT q1y as low-burden CRC entry). No mammography (male) / cervical co-test (male) — female-specific modalities excluded. Validates v0.3 universal demographic RF — male-axis sister case.
